question: SEWA (Self-Employed Women's Association) Bank, a cooperative bank in Gujarat, was launched in India in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1974.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SEWA Bank is a cooperative bank in India that was founded in 1974 by the Self-Employed Women's Association (SEWA), an organization that aims to empower women in the informal sector.**
 
• The bank primarily serves women from low-income households who are engaged in small-scale businesses or self-employment activities, providing them with access to financial services such as savings accounts, loans, and insurance.
 
• **SEWA Bank is known for its customer-centric approach and its efforts to promote financial inclusion among women in India.**
 
• **It has won several awards for its innovative products and services, including the Best Small Bank award at the Business Today-KPMG Best Banks Awards in 2019.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1894 refers to the establishment of the first cooperative bank in India, which was the Cooperative Credit Societies Act of 1904.**

 
 
• ​In 1912, the Cooperative Credit Societies Act of 1904 underwent a revision aimed at extending its scope and facilitating the establishment of non-credit societies.
 
 
 
• 1874 refers to the establishment of the first commercial bank in India, which was the** Bank of Bengal in 1806.**
 
 
• **​**On January 2, 1809, the **Bank of Calcutta,** which was the tenth oldest bank in India, changed its name to **Bank of Bengal. **
 
• **It was primarily established on June 2, 1806, to finance General Wellesley's campaigns against the Marathas and Tipu Sultan. **
 
 

4b
